label: Agathos 2025
setting: low vision rehabilitation clinic (Bicknell Envision Vision Rehabilitation Center; Wichita KS)
diagnosis_mix: age-related macular degeneration 116 (92.8%); hereditary maculopathy (Stargardt's) 9 (7.2%); glaucoma and other peripheral field loss excluded
recruitment: patients with binocular maculopathy and intact peripheral field referred to one clinician's low vision rehabilitation practice over one year; all invited agreed; no accuracy analysis
instruments: GAL-9; Falls and mobility screening questions G1-G5
notes: Not a diagnostic-accuracy study: no sensitivity/specificity against a reference standard; dta.csv empty. n=125 is the enrolled sample; ANOVA df F(2,97) on p13 implies about 100 patients with GAL-9 totals (unexplained). pct_female = (125-26)/125 derived from 26 males (p4). pct_glaucoma 0 because glaucoma patients were excluded (p4). Authors state they do not validate GAL-9 in AMD (p18). VA: ETDRS monocular, habitual correction; CS: LEA symbols binocular (p4)
